title: World's Most Expensive Holiday Destinations Revealed
paragraphs: Where is the most expensive place in the world to go on vacation? According to a new ranking, the answer is Greenland.

The ranking was made by Squaremouth, an American travel insurance company, and it was reported in June 2026. To make the ranking, the company used information from more than 100,000 travel insurance sales and a survey of more than 6,000 customers. It also used data about flights and hotels from Google Flights and Kayak.

Greenland was in first place. A trip there costs an average of $1,171 per day. Flights to Greenland are expensive, and renting a car there costs about $110 per day. Hotels and restaurants are also expensive. Even a cheap dinner costs about $36.

The British Virgin Islands, in the Caribbean, were second. French Polynesia, in the South Pacific, was third. Hotels there are very expensive. A hotel room for one night during the week costs more than $1,300 on average. Antarctica was fourth, and the Maldives were fifth. A trip to Antarctica costs about $1,511 per day, and the flight alone costs about $1,899. Other expensive places included Switzerland, Zimbabwe, Turks and Caicos, Iceland and Norway.

Why are these places so expensive? Many of them are far away and difficult to reach. It also costs a lot to bring food and other things to these places. In addition, many visitors to these places are rich travelers or people looking for adventure.
According to Squaremouth, the most expensive types of trips are trips to polar areas, such as the Arctic and Antarctica. Trips to islands and beaches came next, followed by safaris.
